assessment.classification: PASS: module-level timeout does not locate a declaration or establish semantic falsity, intended negative, OOM, or efficiency. Potential continued processing after an earlier proof error is explicitly a hypothesis, not observation.
assessment.negativeRoot: PASS: copying only original unrelated and negative lift declarations removes the actual consumer as a source of work in that root. A returned intended base mismatch is a meaningful control. Another timeout narrows the candidate work to the lift/its diagnostics and required module processing, not to a unique tactic.
assessment.positiveRoot: PASS: unchanged true-base lift establishes the same K-context equality under real suffix folding. No opaque substitute, axiom or trusted hash introduced. Success remains helper-only.
assessment.consumerRoot: PASS: exact original actual consumer statement is mandatory; only Apply module qualification changes to import the real positive lifted theorem. Successful sourcecheck or helper verification alone cannot accept this bridge.
assessment.discrimination: The separation can distinguish a failing lift phase from a later dedicated consumer phase without dropping the actual product obligation. If dependencies are successful and the later timeout diagnostic names the consumer child, the bound is localized to that consumer module elaboration/checking/conversion. It does not by itself identify a subterm, tactic, or whether hashing versus atomization dominates.
assessment.resourceScope: This changes dependency/module boundaries and therefore may change total verification time and source/artifact identities. The unchanged 300000 ms per-child limit is not a claim of unchanged aggregate budget or improved efficiency. Fresh source identities and actual dependency receipts remain required for each new root.
assessment.supportedConstructs: Only already represented induction, Nat cases, congruence and qualified Apply are proposed. Result errors remain in term matches; no unsupported Result proof Cases or Rewrite/Transitivity is assumed.

candidateAcceptanceRequirements: Freeze new roots and phase configs separately; preserve the original combined candidate, sourcecheck and timeout bytes.

Compare copied declarations structurally: negative lift/unrelated exact original; positive lift/unrelated exact original; consumer statement exact original and proof changed only to qualify the imported lifted theorem. Keep context/runtime/first-state dependencies byte-identical.
Use actual positive lift as a source and kernelchecked dependency of the consumer. Do not inject a host result, admitted theorem, opaque surrogate or precomputed suffix state.

Verify the intended negative first; stop on timeout or unrelated instrument failure. Verify positive lift only after the intended negative and exact candidate review; require consumer after positive success.
Bind each phase to its real source/tool/configuration/lock/epoch and retained receipts. A prior module success cannot authenticate a modified dependency or satisfy a missing artifact gate.
Require actual consumer artifact, kernel evidence and empty-axiom independent audit before bridge acceptance. All three proposed phases currently NOT_RUN.
Keep runtime, exact original257 input,225-byte suffix representation, original limits/digest and proof policy unchanged. No automatic resource increase or equivalent combined-module rerun.
optionalAtomizationLemma: Source-plausible follow-up only, outside this immediate three-root implementation. Its equality/negative remain NOT_RUN and it supplies no assumed rewrite mechanism.
